# OpenFlipbook source mirror

The files in this directory are copied from OpenFlipbook commit `b3e5044` and
used directly by the Guiyang social-world image canvas.

Upstream: <https://github.com/eren23/openflipbook>

Only import paths and product-facing Chinese copy are adapted. The source
layout mirrors the upstream `apps/web/{components/PlayPage,hooks,lib}` layout
so future upstream updates can be reviewed as normal file diffs.
